name: @tirosh-chain/runtime-console-desktop
description: Electron desktop shell for the VitalServer Runtime Console

scripts.package: npm run build && node scripts/package.mjs --target all
scripts.package:macos: npm run build && node scripts/package.mjs --target macos
scripts.package:windows: npm run build && node scripts/package.mjs --target windows
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && node scripts/package.mjs --target linux
scripts.package:linux-deb: npm run build && node scripts/package.mjs --target linux-deb
